name: Tenant virman request settles the owner debt from the tenant advance
title: SC-11-05-01 Tenant virman request settles the owner debt from the tenant advance
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given a tenant with an advance and an owner debt
When the tenant requests a virman and staff approve it
Then the owner debt is settled from the tenant advance
